Biodynamic agriculture

Begin Biodynamic Agriculture: the 24-lesson course →

Available study

Reviewed introductory anthology plus the complete eight-lecture GA 327 Agriculture Course: whole-farm foundations, soils and rhythms, preparations, landscape and animal feeding, including four discussions. Both Agriculture Markdown editions were read; PDF drawings and independently evaluated agricultural outcomes remain outside the review.
